name: sandbox-mode
description: Sandbox mode: a site built from explicit parameters starts from nothing, honours the seed and every setting, and is fully playable through to a blast.

steps.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite seed:777 size:48 depth:24 cash:250000
steps.description: No new_game first — a sandbox site is created from nothing, which is the point of the mode.

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite seed:777 size:48 depth:24 cash:250000

steps.description: Grid extents, biome and seed should all match what was asked for.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:4 depth:6 start:20,20

interaction.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:4 depth:6 start:20,20

steps.description: A sandbox site plays like any other — the blast pipeline runs end to end on it.
